floater.name: sl_first_run
floater.title: WELCOME TO SLIPSTREAM
floater.floater.string: Pick the viewer you used before, or skip this for now.

Pressing / starts chatting (letter keys still move you), right-click opens the round pie menu, chat is shown compact, nearby chat shows as click-through lines over the world, the People button opens your contacts in Conversations, notices stay up longer, the middle mouse button turns your microphone on and off, and you are never set Away on your own.
Slipstream is built on Alchemy, so it already works the way you are used to. Pressing / starts chatting, as in Alchemy; everything else keeps Slipstream's own defaults.

Pressing / starts chatting, holding jump doesn't start flying, your body shows in mouselook, the camera can go anywhere, snapshots are silent, name tags hide group titles, and the middle mouse button turns your microphone on and off.
Press Enter or / to chat in the Conversations window (no chat bar at the bottom), friends' name tags are not highlighted, and the Speak button and middle mouse button turn your microphone on and off.
Slipstream's own settings. Choose this if you are new to Second Life or used a different viewer, or to undo a choice you made here before.
We found your [VIEWER] settings on this computer. You'll see everything before it is imported.
We found your [VIEWER] settings on this computer. You'll see everything before it is imported; chat history comes after you log in (we'll ask then).
Slipstream is now set up like [VIEWER].
Slipstream is set to its own defaults.
Some of the changes take effect after a restart.
floater.text: Which viewer did you use before? We'll set Slipstream up to feel familiar. You can change anything later in Preferences.
